ai_interviews_credit_ck.name: ai_interviews_credit_ck
ai_interviews_credit_ck.value: "ai_interviews"."coverage" <> 'credit' or ("ai_interviews"."credited_from_id" is not null and length("ai_interviews"."credit_note") >= 10)

interview_evaluations_scores_ck.name: interview_evaluations_scores_ck
interview_evaluations_scores_ck.value:
coalesce("interview_evaluations"."communication", 1) between 1 and 10 and coalesce("interview_evaluations"."technical", 1) between 1 and 10
        and coalesce("interview_evaluations"."confidence", 1) between 1 and 10 and coalesce("interview_evaluations"."problem_solving", 1) between 1 and 10
        and coalesce("interview_evaluations"."relevance", 1) between 1 and 10 and coalesce("interview_evaluations"."overall", 0) between 0 and 100

interview_evaluations_submitted_ck.name: interview_evaluations_submitted_ck
interview_evaluations_submitted_ck.value:
"interview_evaluations"."status" <> 'submitted' or ("interview_evaluations"."communication" is not null and "interview_evaluations"."technical" is not null and "interview_evaluations"."confidence" is not null
        and "interview_evaluations"."problem_solving" is not null and "interview_evaluations"."relevance" is not null and "interview_evaluations"."overall" is not null and "interview_evaluations"."writing" is not null
        and "interview_evaluations"."submitted_at" is not null)

mic_numbers_ck.name: mic_numbers_ck
mic_numbers_ck.value:
"mock_interview_config"."minutes_per_question" between 1 and 5 and "mock_interview_config"."wrap_up_minutes" between 0 and 20 and "mock_interview_config"."resume_window_minutes" between 5 and 60
        and "mock_interview_config"."pace_grace_minutes" between 0 and 15 and "mock_interview_config"."booking_valid_days" between 1 and 365
        and "mock_interview_config"."expiry_reminder_days" >= 0 and "mock_interview_config"."expiry_reminder_days" < "mock_interview_config"."booking_valid_days"

payment_orders_kind_period_ck.name: payment_orders_kind_period_ck
payment_orders_kind_period_ck.value: ("payment_orders"."kind"::text = 'ai_interview' and "payment_orders"."period" is null) or ("payment_orders"."kind"::text <> 'ai_interview' and "payment_orders"."period" is not null)
